reviews.text: Simply wonderful, full of competent professionals, and with a fantastic structure. I highly recommend it.
I received excellent care from Dr. Rodrigo Perez. A patient and professional veterinarian. The clinic was very clean.

Excellent service.
I went with my dog ​​and received excellent care from Dr. Mauro. He answered all our questions and calmed us down. Thank God and him, she is doing very well.
The nurses were very careful and attentive.
The receptionist was very friendly.
Thank you for the warm welcome and attention.
I will recommend it to everyone.
My son took our pet for emergency care and we were very well taken care of by Dr. Suzana. She inspired a lot of confidence and was very attentive. I recommend the clinic.

I've been a client of Grajaú Veterinary Clinic for a long time and I couldn't be more satisfied. Dr. Mauro Tupinambá, the owner and technical director of the clinic, is an excellent professional who cared for my three dogs with great competence and dedication—one of them was even born right there at the clinic.

The clinic's facilities are one of its great strengths: modern environments, up-to-date equipment, and a team of efficient professionals committed to the well-being of the animals. Beyond the technical quality, what impressed me most was the caring service. Both I and my pets were always treated with great attention and affection on each visit.

Grajaú Veterinary Clinic is for those seeking excellent veterinary care, with a complete structure and a team truly dedicated to animal care.
We received excellent service, even though it was after 10 pm on a Sunday.
I highly recommend the clinic! Dr. Rodrigo, in addition to being an excellent professional, treats animals with the utmost care.
Excellent service

I will be eternally grateful for all the care I received from Grajaú Veterinary Clinic. They took very good care of my Marley. Even with his serious heart condition and even knowing it was the very end of his life, no one spared any effort to care for him. At no point did they give up on my son. Thank you so much. A very special thank you to Dr. Rodrigo, who is and always will be an angel in our lives. He was tireless with my Marley. Thank you!

Terrible. I lost two cats after taking them there. The second one had an urgent ultrasound, but the doctor only sent the results 24 hours later. Then, when they went to have an X-ray, they sent an assistant to administer it, which I requested from the doctor. After being sedated, he remained sedated on the X-ray machine for almost an hour. I panicked and started crying, begging in the doctor's presence. Another doctor came and started pulling the cat's tongue out. The cat contracted a fecal infection and died in less than 4 days.
Skilled professionals
Excellent.
I've taken my dog ​​there a few times. I've always received excellent care. Dr. Rodrigo Perez is a sweetheart! He lives up to his reputation ❤️❤️❤️

Wonderful clinic and incredible professionals! I especially want to thank Dr. Rosângela Cury, who has always treated my pets with so much care and attention. Her dedication and competence are worthy of praise. I recommend them with complete confidence!
I recommend them. My dogs have been receiving treatment there for years. Excellent work from the entire team.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for about 10 years and we've always received excellent service. Reasonable prices. Good facilities.
Excellent value for money.

One of the worst clinics in Rio. Terrible service; when I arrived they rushed to charge me at reception and gave me an ultrasound without any images. The environment was very dirty. No hygiene whatsoever.

I wanted to thank Dr. Rodrigo for the attention he gave my dog ​​(Fumaça) on June 16th. I had taken her to another clinic and only saw her health worsen. After Dr. Rodrigo's treatment, she was already doing great the next day. Once again, thank you very much, Dr. Rodrigo.

Excellent professionals and a top-notch support team. My pets have been clients since they were young, and now that they are elderly, they are treated with great care and all the gentleness that this age requires.
Dr. Carolina, the cardiologist, is wonderful! Always grateful!

I really liked it. I took my puppy to get 3 vaccines today and the care and attention from the person administering the vaccines, as well as the kindness and attention from Dr. Carolina, was perfect. I was very satisfied.

Many years ago, it was excellent. Now, I don't know anymore... I took my cat, who was bleeding and in pain, for an emergency consultation. As soon as I arrived, I told the receptionist it was an emergency. When I got there, she still wanted to register me, chatted with other employees, eager to leave. I waited about 20 minutes and nobody came to attend to an EMERGENCY. When I left, the receptionist even questioned if I had given up. I said yes, because it was an EMERGENCY. She rudely asked what kind of emergency it was (which should have been done BEFORE). I answered and went to the Uberaba Veterinary Clinic, which did have fast and efficient service for the situation.

Excellent service, a very well-prepared and friendly team. My cat had eye surgery at the clinic, had a great recovery, and received excellent support. I especially recommend Dr. Rosângela; she's great, attentive, and closely monitors cases. It's the only place I trust to take my cats.

I'm writing to thank Dr. Rodrigo, Dr. Rosangela, and the entire inpatient team, from the doctors to the nurses, for their professionalism!!!

In addition to being attentive and caring.

I arrived on a holiday with Lucky (who had received a wrong diagnosis from another clinic).
They immediately performed a consultation and then admitted him for a 4-day treatment**.
They were spot on 🙌.

Thank you so much***
May God bless you with good health**
And also the very caring and polite receptionists**
I'm Alessandra Barros (the pet's aunt).
Always very good.

I would like to highlight the excellent care provided by Drs. Rosângela and Viviane, who ensured my grandson dog's prompt recovery from his illness. I must also thank the doctors, the nursing staff, and the receptionists.

I would like to thank Doctors Rosangela and Viviane for the excellent care they provided to my pet. Attentive, dedicated, and caring. Top-notch professionals. The nurses and reception staff are also very attentive. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
